title: Lava Pull
description: Turns vanilla lava into a harmless fluid that pulls entities inward and spreads more like water.
body:
Instead of acting like normal lava, it becomes harmless to entities, pulls them inward, and spreads more like water.
  The mod directly changes vanilla lava, so there are no new blocks, no extra fluids, and no extra items to learn.

  ## Features

  - vanilla lava no longer burns entities
  - lava pulls entities toward its center
  - lava spreads more like water
  - animated lava textures are included

    ## Notes

  This is a gameplay-changing mod and will affect normal lava behavior in survival, creative, and world generation
  wherever vanilla lava exists.
